# Attempts

- [Building SwiftTerm with xcodebuild without trusting its plug-in](DVDV-1-building-swiftterm-with-xcodebuild-without-trusting-its-plug.md): Phase 2 stopped because SwiftTerm's build plug-in fails Xcode validation until a person clicks Trust & Enable once per Mac and version.
- [Default NSHostingController sizing for the menubar popover](DVDV-2-default-nshostingcontroller-sizing-for-the-menubar-popover.md): Letting NSHostingController keep its default sizingOptions inside the menubar NSPopover was dropped because the popover opened about 217 pt below the icon.
- [Factory Test check appending a test file path to xcodebuild](DVDV-1-factory-test-check-appending-a-test-file-path-to-xcodebuild.md): Six fix rounds on slice 1 failed because Factory passed a test file path as a bare xcodebuild argument, which xcodebuild rejects.
- [Leaving the tab pointer rules and the tab step in the App target](DVDV-4-leaving-the-tab-pointer-rules-and-the-tab-step-in-the-app-ta.md): Slice 3 kept the button rules inside the AppKit catcher and the Previous/Next step inside TabStrip, which left six acceptance criteria without tests until a fix round moved them into DevDevCore.
- [Literal centre-passes-middle rule at the ends of the tab strip](DVDV-4-literal-centre-passes-middle-rule-at-the-ends-of-the-tab-str.md): Giving a dragged tab a neighbour's place only when its centre passes that neighbour's middle was dropped at the strip's ends, because a wide tab could never reach an end held by a narrower tab.
- [Measuring the auto-restart delay from when events arrive](DVDV-4-measuring-the-auto-restart-delay-from-when-events-arrive.md): AutoRestartTests timed the restart delay by when a test subscriber received the crash and running events, which failed at random under load.
- [Moving a tab in a WindowModel test before both tabs showed](DVDV-4-moving-a-tab-in-a-windowmodel-test-before-both-tabs-showed.md): The first model test for moveTab moved a tab whose setup had not finished, timed out, and stayed flaky for a while after the fix.
- [Parsing the dev:list text table](DVDV-1-parsing-the-devlist-text-table.md): Reading the plain dev:list table was ruled out because it is cut to terminal width and rewritten under AI-agent environments.
- [Renaming a manual-checklist item without the same change in the final report](DVDV-5-renaming-a-manual-checklist-item-without-the-same-change-in.md): The docs slice renamed an item in docs/manual-checklist.md but not in docs/final-report.md, which failed a BuildRecordTests test and cost two fix rounds.
- [Signalling only the leader's process group on Stop](DVDV-1-signalling-only-the-leaders-process-group-on-stop.md): Stopping a Process by signalling only its leader's group was dropped because interactive zsh moves jobs into other groups and ignores SIGTERM.
- [SMAppService login item for an ad hoc signed Helper](DVDV-1-smappservice-login-item-for-an-ad-hoc-signed-helper.md): The login-item API was tried for launch at login and dropped because launchd refuses every rebuilt Helper after a reinstall.
